pages.text: Each output has a Create value box on its sides. Use it, as on any Create machine, to choose what happens $(item)When Internal Tank is Full$(): $(li)$(item)Stop Distillation Process$() (default): a full output stops taking its product.

The other outputs keep working, and only the oil for the products actually stored is used. $(li)$(item)Void Excess Fluid$(): the output keeps accepting its share and destroys whatever does not fit. The tower never slows down.

Use the void mode on products you do not want yet, so they never block anything, and the default mode on the fuels you sell or burn. A few habits keep a refinery running: $(li)Pump every output somewhere, even into a plain tank, and add more storage as the factory grows.

$(li)Send the heavy oil from the bottom output to a heavy oil tower, to bitumen, or back into the crude tank. $(li)Burn surplus gases in a $(item)flarestack$() (see the next chapter) instead of voiding them. $(li)Keep the steel tank topped up: an empty tank stops the tower, not a full one.
